name: Customized Home
description: Customized Home lets every user reorganize the Jellyfin home screen: reorder sections by drag and drop, show or hide them, choose a display format per section (poster, landscape, square, size, titles) and search among all known sections. Optional hero banner at the top: a carousel of featured media (random, recently added, latest releases) with backdrop, logo, synopsis, ratings and play / resume / trailer / favorite actions. Adds its own sections without any other plugin: Continue Watching / Next Up combined, latest movies and shows by release date, collections, watch again, because you watched, genre. Works with the built-in sections and with sections added by other plugins (Home Screen Sections, ...). Administrators define a default layout. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Easily edit and organize the sections on your homepage
